question_text: What can be done during AI development to minimize bias?

choices.text: Collect massive amounts of data for training.
Focus on accuracy of the data.
Use diverse data, fairness metrics, and human oversight.
Improve on the computational efficiency and speed.

comments.author: ysuzukix
comments.text:
To minimize bias and ensure fairness in AI systems, a multi-faceted approach is required throughout the development lifecycle:
Diverse data: Training the model with balanced datasets that reflect various demographics (age, gender, ethnicity, etc.) rather than a specific group.
Fairness metrics: Utilizing mathematical measurements to evaluate whether the model's decisions are fair and unbiased.
Human oversight: Implementing a "Human-in-the-loop" approach where humans monitor and review the AI's performance and decisions.
Therefore, C is the most comprehensive and correct answer.

comments.author: amatoug
comments.text: Use diverse data, fairness metrics, and human oversight.

comments.author: Kosey
comments.text:
✅ Correct Answer: C
❌ A. Collect massive amounts of data for training
More data does not automatically reduce bias. If the data is biased, increasing volume can actually amplify that bias.
❌ B. Focus on accuracy of the data
Accuracy alone isn’t enough. Data can be accurate but still unrepresentative or unfair toward certain groups.
✅ C. Use diverse data, fairness metrics, and human oversight
Minimizing bias requires:
Diverse and representative datasets
Fairness metrics to measure and detect bias
Human oversight to review, adjust, and make ethical judgments
This is the best-practice approach in responsible AI development.
❌ D. Improve on the computational efficiency and speed
Efficiency and speed affect performance, not bias or fairness.
